comment: What the app may do with each shop, by the shop's published conditions (docs/data-sources-terms.md, checked 2026-11-07). links: 'allowed' shows a 'View in the shop' link that a person entered by hand; anything else shows no link. auto_collection: 'allowed' would permit a scheduled collector; no shop has it. Both are 'unconfirmed' for every shop until a written basis (the shop's terms, an API or feed with explicit conditions) is recorded in `basis`.
